brief.headline: Neutral tape, energy leads; ASML post-earnings drop demands attention
brief.regime_summary: SPY sits 0.29% above its 50DMA and 6.7% above its 200DMA, essentially flat to trend after a 1% weekly decline. VIX at 17.49 is elevated versus its 20DMA of 15.52, signalling a modest uptick in realized fear, but not yet a risk-off signal. Breadth is the concern: only 36% of sectors trade above their 50DMA. Sector momentum tilts defensively, with energy (XLE +6.3%), healthcare (XLV +4.1%) and staples (XLP +4.0%) leading over 20 days, while financials, real estate and communication services lag. In this environment, breakouts carry less follow-through than they would with 60%+ breadth, so require stronger confirmation before adding exposure.

portfolio.note: Price 533.69, 3.4% above 20DMA, RSI 62.5, in full bull MA stack. Earnings October 28 are the near-term event: at 30.3x trailing P/E (6.5% premium to history) the bar is not low, so watch for any estimate revision ahead of the print.

Down 8.6% on the week to 1650, now 6.4% below its 20DMA and 11.9% off its 20-day high. RSI at 38 and 40-day momentum negative at -8.5%. Earnings were due October 14; the move implies a disappointing print or guidance cut. Cost basis 820 gives 101% unrealised gain as a buffer, but the thesis needs re-checking against the actual results.

Up 6.7% on the week to 67.63, RSI 72.0 and just 0.1% off its 20-day high. Position is still underwater at cost 88. The energy sector leads 20-day momentum but is overbought; watch for a pullback toward the 20DMA before adding, and note that a mean-reversion in crude would quickly reverse this week's gains.

Price 375.99, 2.6% below its 20DMA, momentum negative at -4.0% (20-day) and -5.7% (40-day), RSI 39.2. Gold futures (GC=F) confirm the trend with 20-day mom at -5.0% and 5.9% below the 20-day high. The hedge is not working in a neutral-to-risk-on tape; assess whether the allocation still earns its place.

watchlist.name: Shopify Inc.
watchlist.thesis: Price 172.50 is 12.5% above its 20DMA and 30.2% above its 100DMA, with 20-day momentum of 32.7%, the strongest on the screen. RSI is 67.7, not yet overbought. EPS revisions are net positive (7 up, 0 down in 30 days) and forward PE of 70x is in line with historical median. Earnings are November 3, leaving three weeks for the trend to develop or extend.
watchlist.risk: Headline momentum at 32.7% is already steep; in 36% breadth tape a broad pullback would hurt the highest-beta leaders first.

watchlist.name: Accenture plc
watchlist.thesis: Up 10.2% on the week to 214.96, now 11.9% above its 20DMA. EPS estimates are up 5.7% and revenue estimates up 5.3% over 30 days, with 12 analysts revising up versus 7 down. Forward PE of 13.5x is inexpensive for the revision momentum. Next earnings December 17 leave a long runway.
watchlist.risk: The weekly move of 10% in a neutral tape is extended; a reversion toward the 20DMA would not be unusual and would not break the trend.

watchlist.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.

watchlist.risk: Any guidance miss at the November 2 print would remove the primary earnings-growth support for the valuation.

watchlist.risk: Bearish DMA stack in the data is anomalous given the price action; confirm the longer-term stack before using it as a signal. RSI above 72 means little room for disappointment.
